videos.title: Janet Jumper
videos.description: Vertical product video: a model in Honey Tribe's army-green Janet Jumper (a wide-leg jumpsuit with striped tie suspenders) in an arched, plant-filled set, with captions on the relaxed fit, adjustable suspenders, pockets and convertible ankles. Ends on a Honey Tribe 'Shop Now' card with shophoneytribe.com.

videos.title: Milo Tassel Kimono
videos.description: Vertical product video: a model styles the pink colour-block Milo Tassel Kimono with cream tassels, with bold word-by-word captions about layering it over different outfits. Ends on a Honey Tribe end card.

videos.title: Knox Tassel Kimono
videos.description: Vertical product video: the green, yellow and tan Knox Tassel Kimono worn in a sunlit room, with serif captions such as 'easy to layer and designed to move with you'. Ends on a Honey Tribe end card.

videos.title: Proverbs 3:5 Scripture Sweatpants
videos.description: Vertical product video: yellow wide-leg sweatpants whose side zip opens to a Proverbs 3:5 scripture print, with captions on the stretch waist, pockets, zippers and inseam. Ends on a Honey Tribe end card.

videos.title: Not just parking. A full RV getaway.
videos.description: Vertical promo: the Eagle River, aerial views and RV sites with captions such as 'Wake up to the calm of the Eagle River.', then an offer card with nightly and weekly rates and the Riverdance RV Resort logo.
videos.source: videos/Riverdance & HoneyTribe-20261005T143802Z-1-001/Not just parking. A full RV getaway..mp4

videos.title: A place to park your RV
videos.description: Vertical drone video of Riverdance RV Resort in Gypsum, Colorado: canyon, river, RV rows and cabins, with hand-lettered captions ('Looking for a place to park your RV?', 'Your home base in Gypsum Colorado'), a Book Now! button and the resort logo.

videos.title: Angle 1: the weekly rent figure
videos.description: Vertical talking-head ad for Rooming House Expert: a presenter explains that a big weekly rent figure isn't the number that matters, with captions, a floor-plan animation and a mock-up of the free 'Ultimate Rooming House Conversion Guide'. Ends on the Rooming House Expert logo. The e-mail address on the guide mock-up is blurred.

videos.title: Angle 2: more rent isn't a better investment
videos.description: Vertical talking-head ad for Rooming House Expert: 'more rent does not automatically mean better investment', with captions, b-roll (paperwork, a route map, a calculator), the free guide mock-up and the Rooming House Expert logo. The e-mail address on the guide mock-up is blurred.

videos.title: Angle 3: what is actually left
videos.description: Vertical talking-head ad for Rooming House Expert: what is left after costs decides whether a rooming house strategy works, with animated icons (layout, demand, management, vacancy, compliance, expenses), the free guide mock-up and the Rooming House Expert logo. The e-mail address on the guide mock-up is blurred.

videos.title: Custom Is Chaos, Stratos Is Control
videos.description: Vertical talking-head video: a presenter in a rounded frame with orange-highlighted captions contrasts custom builds with the standardised 9-studio Stratos rooming house system, cut with stock b-roll of plans, builders and paperwork, a 'Custom Is Chaos / The Stratos Is Control' title card and the Super Cashflow Developments logo.
videos.source: videos/Super Cahsflow-20261005T143809Z-1-001/Custom is Chaos Stratos is Control .mp4

videos.title: Stop treating rooming houses like normal houses
videos.description: Vertical talking-head video: opens on 'this is why most rooming house projects fall apart', then covers Class 1B requirements (access, fire separation, ventilation, soundproofing) with stock b-roll and listing photos ('6 bedrooms, multiple bathrooms, professionally managed'). Ends on the Super Cashflow Developments logo.
videos.source: videos/Super Cahsflow-20261005T143809Z-1-001/Stop treating rooming houses like normal houses.mp4

videos.title: The income is obvious, the process is the problem
videos.description: Vertical talking-head video: the presenter argues that rooming-house income is easy to see but the process (council permits, builders, compliance) is where projects stall, and introduces the Stratos system, with stock b-roll. Ends on the Super Cashflow Developments logo.
videos.source: videos/Super Cahsflow-20261005T143809Z-1-001/The income is obvious the process is the problem.mp4
